hints.tr: Saat için iki seçenek: `[01]\d` (00–19) ya da `2[0-3]` (20–23); `|` ile, parantez içinde.
hints.en: Two options for the hour: `[01]\d` (00–19) or `2[0-3]` (20–23); with `|`, in parentheses.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
import re

time = input("Time: ").strip()

if re.fullmatch(r"([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d", time):
    print("Valid")
else:
    print("Invalid")
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
import re

time = input("Time: ").strip()

if re.fullmatch(r"([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d", time):
    print("Valid")
else:
    print("Invalid")
```
